settings.text: Hot-water bottles that slide off and go cold in minutes
Wired heat pads that keep you pinned next to a plug socket
One-size supports that pinch, slip, or cut off at the wrong spot
A different gadget for your knee, your elbow, and your shoulder
Three heat settings — 45°C, 50°C and 65°C — so you choose what feels right
Gentle vibration massage alongside the warmth, at the press of a button
Cordless 4000mAh battery: use it on the sofa, at the desk, or in the garden
Adjustable straps that wrap knees, elbows and shoulders alike

settings.problem_heading: Rubbing your knee at the top of the stairs isn't a routine.
settings.solution_heading: One wrap. Steady warmth. Anywhere you need it.

settings.title: Three heat settings
settings.text: Choose 45°C, 50°C or 65°C — from barely-there warmth to a proper deep heat, adjusted with one button.

settings.title: Gentle vibration massage
settings.text: A soft vibration setting works alongside the heat for a soothing, spa-like feel on tired joints.

settings.title: Cordless 4000mAh battery
settings.text: Rechargeable and fully cordless — no trailing wires, no being stuck by the socket.

settings.title: Knee, elbow & shoulder
settings.text: One wrap fits all three. The pair set covers both knees — or a knee and a shoulder — at once.

settings.title: Soft adjustable fit
settings.text: Wide hook-and-loop straps adjust to your build and hold the wrap comfortably in place.

settings.title: CE, FCC & RoHS certified
settings.text: Meets recognised international safety standards, with no high-concern chemicals.

settings.heading: Small wrap, big end-of-day difference
settings.subheading: Every detail is there to make winding down easier.

settings.title: Wrap it around
settings.text: Place the pad over your knee, elbow or shoulder and fasten the soft straps until it feels snug.

settings.title: Pick your warmth
settings.text: Press the button to cycle 45°C, 50°C or 65°C — and add the vibration setting if you fancy it.

settings.title: Sit back for 15 minutes
settings.text: Let the warmth settle in while you read, watch TV, or put the kettle on. Recharge when the battery runs low.

settings.heading: Three steps to a warmer, calmer evening

settings.feature: Stays in place while you move
